observation_policy.description: Compare the latest usable observation on or before the completed Friday with the latest usable observation on or before the prior Friday. Every fact retains its actual observation date.
observation_policy.threshold_scope: Display/interpretation heuristics only. They are not estimated probabilities, optimized trading rules, or inputs to USD Impact Score v2.

labels.fact: Externally sourced or transparently derived completed observations.
labels.interpretation: Deterministic qualitative reading of the three dials using the published display thresholds.
labels.model_output: Separate USD Impact Score v2 output; not evidence that the qualitative interpretation is predictive.

facts.label: U.S. Dollar Index (DXY proxy)
facts.source_note: Accessible/reproducible Yahoo Finance proxy for DX-Y.NYB; not represented as exchange-official or a licensed institutional feed.

facts.label: Nominal Broad U.S. Dollar Index
facts.source_note: Federal Reserve H.10 broad-dollar confirmation inside Dial 1; it is not a separate fourth dial.

facts.label: 10-year TIPS real yield
facts.source_note: 10-year inflation-indexed Treasury yield; the primary real-rate observation for Dial 2.

facts.label: 10-year nominal Treasury yield
facts.source_note: Nominal 10-year Treasury yield shown only as rate context for Dial 2.

facts.label: ICE BofA U.S. High Yield option-adjusted spread
facts.source_note: ICE BofA series displayed through FRED. Only the two observations used by this snapshot are republished.

facts.label: CBOE Volatility Index: VIX
facts.source_note: CBOE VIX displayed through FRED. Only the two observations used by this snapshot are republished.

facts.label: SOFR minus IORB funding spread
facts.provider: New York Fed and Federal Reserve Board via FRED
facts.source_note: Derived as SOFR minus IORB (FRED series IORB) in basis points. It is funding context, not a standalone liquidity measure.

interpretation.label: Mixed / transitional environment
interpretation.sentence: The completed week showed a rangebound DXY reading with mixed broad-dollar confirmation, 10-year real yields rising, and liquidity-stress evidence was mixed.
interpretation.scope: Descriptive interpretation of completed observations; not a forecast or trading signal.

model_output.name: USD Impact Score v2
model_output.scope: Separate descriptive model output. It is not an input to the Three-Dial interpretation and is not a forecast.

disclosures: Dated snapshot, not real-time market data. Observation dates are shown for every fact.
Broad USD is a confirmation layer inside Dial 1, not a fourth dial.
The SOFR-minus-IORB spread is one funding-context indicator and is not treated as a complete measure of liquidity.
VIX and ICE BofA High Yield OAS are third-party series accessed through FRED; this snapshot republishes only the two observations needed for the completed-week comparison, not their full histories.
The Three-Dial interpretation is descriptive and deterministic. It is not investment advice, a trading signal, a probability, or a return forecast.
